t: What he was told to ask for in the dream
a: أَسْأَلُكَ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَتَرْكَ الْمُنْكَرَاتِ وَحُبَّ الْمَسَاكِينِ وَإِذَا أَرَدْتَ بِعِبَادِكَ فِتْنَةً فَاقْبِضْنِي إِلَيْكَ غَيْرَ مَفْتُونٍ
p: Asʾaluka fiʿla-l-khayrāt, wa tarka-l-munkarāt, wa ḥubba-l-masākīn. Wa idhā aradta bi-ʿibādika fitnatan fa-qbiḍnī ilayka ghayra maftūn
m: I ask You for the doing of good things, and the leaving of wrong things, and the love of the poor. And when You intend a trial for Your servants, take me to Yourself untried by it.
